Notable that his one substantive question about the core product was a safety question, and that the answer he received — 'it's not an issue' plus a near-promise of 99.9% symptom removal — closed the topic rather than opening it.

unmet_demand.want: A definitive, competent answer on whether loaded ballistic kettlebell work is safe for someone with scoliosis and two recently rehabilitated knees who has been advised against lifting
unmet_demand.why_unmet: He asked the question twice and received reassurance in place of assessment — an employee anecdote, 'it's not an issue', an unspecified reference to sending x-rays, and 'what I can nearly promise you is that we're going to remove at least 99.9% of the discomfort or pain that you're going through.' No clinician was involved, none was suggested, and his own physical therapist and personal trainer were never contacted or even asked about. This is the single most important open item in this record and it is flagged for a human.

unmet_demand.why_unmet: Asked directly at 00:32:11 and deferred: 'Save that for your conversation with Trevor.' He committed $9,000 without any stated outcome, timeline or measure, on a call where the only quantified promise made was the 99.9% pain figure.

unmet_demand.want: A programme usable without a conventional smartphone
unmet_demand.why_unmet: He uses a Wise Phone with no internet and a restricted app whitelist, and the delivery model had just been described as centralised in an app plus Skool community access. Given that the feedback loop requires him to film himself weekly and upload it, this is a practical adherence risk nobody tested.

unmet_demand.want: Resolution of chronic daily back discomfort as the primary purchase outcome
unmet_demand.why_unmet: This is what he is buying — 'just something that I can use to take care of my back... I'm looking for a solution to these back issues that I have.' The programme was positioned as delivering it near-totally. Whether it does, for a scoliotic spine with asymmetric paraspinal development, is not established anywhere in this transcript by anyone qualified to establish it.
